scientific_conclusion: NCT is classified IN_DOMAIN by the inherited ESOL applicability rule, but only narrowly above the frozen threshold.
The frozen ESOL predictor underpredicts the exact AqSolDB NCT source observation by 2.3096117645502643 logS units.
A single measured-anchor discrepancy is not a new validation benchmark and does not justify retraining or post-hoc correction.
The observed error means ESOL absolute logS should not be treated as a reliable ground-truth ranking signal for a future NCT analog series.

Future NCT analog generation may still record ESOL predictions and per-analog applicability-domain status, but selection should preserve the measured-anchor discrepancy and require independent local coverage/evidence rather than silently calibrating the model to NCT.
